tei:div.tei:p: 343) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rgyun khyer tshogs mchod bsdus pa bzhugs: na mo padma kā ra ye: spros med don gyi rnal 'byor pas: bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs rnams kun: zag med bde chen bdud rtsir brlabs: lha yi sa ma ti yi ngang: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos dbyings rnam dag bhandha ru: gzhi snang lhun grub tshogs gtor bshams: kun bzang mchod sprin bla na med: bde stong ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: rang bzhin rnam dag zhing khams nas: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dang: yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug lha: gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i spyi dpal mchog: mkhyen rab mnga' bdag 'jam dpal dbyangs: sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i tshogs bcas la: 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs mchod 'bul: gnyis med bde chen ngang du rol: bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs phyir: lta ba mtha' bral ngang du bskang: sgom pa zang thal chen por bskang: spyod pa spang blang bral bar bskang: 'bras bu ye rdzogs chen por bskang: sdom gsum bsrung mtshams las 'das pa: ye bsrung chos sku'i klong du 345)bshags: gzung 'dzin gnyis snang dbyings su bsgral: bdag med mnyam nyid klong du bstabs: gsang gsum byin rlabs dbang dngos grub: tshims pa drug ldan ngang du rol: a la la ho siddhi hūm̐: lhag pa'i lha yi dkyil 'khor du: tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyas shog: pheṃ: lhag skyong pho mos lhag gtor rol: ci bcol phrin las yongs 'grub mdzod: utstshiṣṭa bha liṃ ta khā hi: tshogs mchod phul ba'i bsod nams dge: 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngo: zung 'jug ye shes sku thob nas: mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shog: 'di la rgyun du brtson gyur na: phyi nang bar chad kun sel nas: tshogs gnyis 'bras bu mthar phyin te: tshe 'dir don gnyis 'grub par nges: the tshom med do sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: : ces pa'ang snga 'gyur bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen po zhabs drung skyabs mgon rin po ches bkra shis lha rdzas sna tshogs bcas bkas bskul zab phyir ma ldog tsam du dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las dbyi shod gdan sa chen po'i nye char lha brag rin chen rdzong gi nye 'dabs o rgyan phug nas su kha badzra gyis nyams chos yig ris su bris pa dge'o//
